# Vendored: code_exec

`__init__.py` and `runner.py` are copied verbatim from [IvanMurzak/Code-Exec](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Code-Exec)
`python/code_exec/` at release **0.4.0** (tag `nuget-v0.4.0`, commit `58ef3ed5b7e42d10f00fa02c0c3531db97fdfdf3`). Do not
edit them here: change Code-Exec, then copy the files again and update this note. The contract they implement is Code-Exec's `spec/contract.md` (sections 4 and 6: the runtime also clips the value, the logs and the error).
